notes: lumira-auth owns authentication orchestration; credential and challenge persistence is written by lumira-system system/user and system/verification adapters.
Account activation lifecycle and token persistence are owned by lumira-system/modules/account; Expert only updates expert state through the shared port.
IAM is the canonical identity-master owner for sys_user and iam_*; Account and Auth use identity ports and never write sys_user directly.
Platform data and the shared platform event store are runtime-owned by lumira-system; File and Message retain source-scoped producer lanes through the table-level exception.
Activity and registrations are runtime-owned only by lumira-activity.
Competition registration review and certificate data are runtime-owned only by lumira-competition.
Rebuildable public Activity and Competition projection is runtime-owned only by lumira-event-catalog.
Project catalog data is runtime-owned only by lumira-project.
Expert applications and expert approval state are runtime-owned only by lumira-expert; account activation token state belongs to ACCOUNT.
Workflow definitions instances tasks and action logs are runtime-owned only by lumira-workflow.
Export task persistence is runtime-owned only by lumira-export.
Message tables are runtime-owned by lumira-message; its source-scoped platform_event_outbox writer is a declared shared-table exception.
Alert rules instances and delivery state are runtime-owned by lumira-alerting; channel delivery remains owned by lumira-message.
File tables and the File domain event receipt/projection are runtime-owned by lumira-file; its source-scoped platform_event_outbox writer is a declared shared-table exception.
Plugin lifecycle data is runtime-owned only by lumira-plugin.
Localization tables are runtime-owned only by lumira-localization.
Payment tables are runtime-owned only by lumira-payment.
AI assistant and knowledge-base data is runtime-owned only by lumira-ai.
Team core business data is runtime-owned only by lumira-team.
XXL-JOB scheduler schema is external technical infrastructure; lumira-quartz is only an adapter.
